title: Round 9 (v9): confirm the main-line stack (98k SNP + P3 + non-linear genetic stage) and isolate the EC increment, including a true external validation on G2F 2022-2023; secondary deep-model check on GPU
status: FROZEN before any 2022-2023 phenotype is analysed (the download only verified file sizes and year/env counts) and before any R9 model is fitted. The v8 post-hoc ablation (D_noEC vs D_full) generated H9a/H9b; settings used in that ablation (S1 LOYO, S2 LOLO) are REPLICATION only.
compute: amax only (per user 2026-09-29): all files under <server>/egp_gxe; env <server>/egp_gxe/envs/egp311; CPU <= 48 threads total; GPU: one H200 (shared host). All folds of a given setting are computed on the same machine; no cross-machine mixing within a setting.

data.G2F_2025_release: <server>/egp_gxe/data/g2f_2025/Training_data (CyVerse 10.25739/78mn-4394; trait/meta/weather/EC 2014-2023). The whole v9 pipeline is rebuilt from these files; before any model fit, report agreement of the 2014-2021 subset with the local 2014-2021 files used in R1-R8 (row counts, env set, yield values).
data.dense_genotypes: 98k SNP set (P8 figshare MAP.csv) for all hybrids 2014-2023. If the G2F inbred 437k VCF (CyVerse 10.25739/ragt-7213) is obtainable, hybrid dosages at the 98k positions are built as parent1 + parent2 inbred calls; validity check on hybrids present in the P8 GENO matrix: per-SNP dosage concordance >= 0.98 median and kinship correlation >= 0.95. If unobtainable or the check fails, EXT settings use the 2k SNP set only and every 98k contrast is restricted to S4 (declared, no threshold change).

settings.EXT_2022: train 2014-2021, test 2022 (test env inclusion >= 30 genotyped hybrids with yield)
settings.EXT_pooled: EXT_2022 and EXT_2023 test envs pooled (primary external setting)
settings.S4_G2F_CV00: as v8 (years 2014-2021 only, same location folds rng 20260929)

tuning: P3 grouped inner CV (leave-one-training-year-out for EXT and S4) is the only protocol used for decisions; penalty grid 1e-2..1e7 (19 values) as v8; HGB n_iter from {50,100,200,400,800} chosen by the same inner folds; P1/P2 reported for the audit only.

models.MG_2k: SNP main effects only, 2k SNP set
models.MG_98k: SNP main effects only, 98k SNP set (kernel ridge as R6/R8)
models.D_noEC(stage1): two-stage: stage 1 = MG_(2k|98k) tuned by P3; stage 2 = HistGradientBoosting (learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, min_samples_leaf 200, random_state 20260928) on stage-1 residuals cross-fitted over the P3 inner groups, features = PC1..30 (from the same SNP set as stage 1) + predicted phenology (round-1 maturity ridge)
models.D_full(stage1): as D_noEC plus EC_env (21 G2F variables, raw) as stage-2 features

H9a_nonlinear_genetic_stage.CONFIRMED: >= 0.01 with paired env-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 in BOTH settings

H9b_EC_increment.CONFIRMED: >= 0.005 with CI lower > 0 in BOTH settings

settings: EXT_pooled (only if dense genotypes pass the validity check)
H9c_stack_on_dense_snp.CONFIRMED: >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0 in every available setting

H9d_dense_snp_external.note: external replication of R8 Q1 with SNP-only models

secondary_no_gate.window_search_leak_external: CERIS nested vs leaky env-mean r on EXT_pooled as R7 H1 (report optimism and CI)
secondary_no_gate.deep_model_check_GPU: two-tower MLP in PyTorch: genotype tower = linear(98k or 2k SNP -> 512) + GELU + dropout 0.3 + linear(512 -> 128); env tower = linear(EC_env(21) + predicted phenology -> 64) + GELU; head = MLP([128+64] -> 128 -> 1) on the concatenation; target = env-centred yield; AdamW lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, batch 1024, max 60 epochs, early stopping on one inner validation year (the training year nearest the test year); 5 seeds, predictions averaged. Variants DL_full and DL_noEC (env tower removed). Report r(DL_full), r(DL_noEC), their difference and differences vs MG_98k, with CIs, on S4 and EXT_pooled. Declared as a robustness check of H9b, not a confirmatory test.

metric_and_uncertainty: within-env Pearson of yield, equal-weight mean over test envs; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928; Holm across H9a-H9d reported alongside; new-hybrid subset reported

decision.MAINLINE: H9a and H9c CONFIRMED -> default = 98k SNP + P3 + non-linear genetic stage; H9a only -> non-linear stage adopted with 2k; neither -> keep 98k SNP + P3
decision.C_PAPER: H9b NEGLIGIBLE or INCONCLUSIVE -> 'EC adds < 0.01 within-environment' reported as confirmed/unresolved accordingly; H9b CONFIRMED -> report a small but real non-linear EC increment

reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
